Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad is 31 August 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA in Economics (or MA Honours in Economics) or an MSc in Economics. Related master's degrees in fields like data science, data analytics, business analytics, or public policy may also be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIM Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What kind of technical skills are required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates are expected to have proficiency in programming languages and software such as Python, R, and Excel. Familiarity with ESG, climate policy, and sustainable finance is also considered desirable.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad is contractual, as indicated in the recruitment details.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Research Associate at IIM Ahmedabad through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIM Ahmedabad offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age limits and any applicable age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here and should be confirmed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How should I submit my application for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIM Ahmedabad or via the 'Apply Online' link provided in the 'Important Links' section, on or before the last date of application.
